title: Free Discord Nitro - link expires tonight
scenario: A DM from someone in your server says they're giving away free Discord Nitro, but the link only works for the next 20 minutes and needs you to log in.

answers.A: Log in quickly before the offer expires.
answers.B: Skip it. Real Nitro gifts come from Discord itself or a friend you already trust, not a countdown link in a DM.
answers.C: Log in, and also send the link to your friends before it expires.

explanation: Fake Nitro gift links are one of the most common Discord phishing scams, built to steal your login the moment you enter it under a fake deadline.
proTip: A countdown on a login page is designed to stop you from thinking - that's the whole trick.
